figures.finding: Liechtenstein has no film agreement or film fund of its own to speak of: its documentary makers worked without professional film infrastructure and with no state film funding to speak of, and the state's Cultural Foundation (Kulturstiftung Liechtenstein) gave audiovisual media five per cent of its 2019 budget, chiefly to the Skino cinema and two film clubs.
figures.applies: Liechtenstein; Compendium of Cultural Policies country profile (read 2026-11-01).

sources.said: As there was no professional infrastructure for film production in Liechtenstein, intensive in terms of materials, personnel and costs, and no state film funding to speak of, they were largely limited to low-cost video productions. … The Liechtenstein Cultural Foundation supported the project and has also concluded performance agreements with the Skino Film Club and the Liechtenstein Film and Video Club. A total of five per cent of the Cultural Foundation’s 2019 budget went towards audiovisual media.

figures.finding: German is the national and official language of Liechtenstein.

sources.said: Art 6 The German language is the national and official language.

figures.finding: Vaduz is the capital and seat of Parliament and Government; no production centre is named in any source found.

sources.said: Vaduz is the capital and the seat of Parliament and the Government.

blockers.sought: The stage actor's minimum: an agreement, a rate card or a statutory rule setting a stage actor's pay, or a source saying none does.

tried.web-search: WebSearch (6 of 10, standard): 'Liechtenstein Theater Schauspieler Gage Mindestlohn Gesamtarbeitsvertrag Bühne TAK Autor Tantiemen Filmförderung Serie' (producer blocker: series incentive and fund, theatre fund; items 8, 9) (the stage actor's minimum, the methods round of 2026-11-04). Result: No Liechtenstein agreement, fee, royalty or series fund. Leads: the Compendium of Cultural Policies' Liechtenstein profile (culturalpolicies.net), TAK job ads (unibas.ch 2020; theaterschweiz.ch 2025, which answered 404), a LANV download (the Baumeister-Lohn- und Protokollvereinbarung 2022-23, a construction wage agreement: files/m10/li-lanv-97.bin, sha256 99bd559a66a879a3caaee86917ada537aa2fcd142c671bc894866496ac054a90), German NV Bühne and Swiss free-theatre guideline fees (not Liechtenstein's).
tried.institution: TAK Theater Liechtenstein: home https://www.tak.li/ , Ensemble https://www.tak.li/ensemble (files/m10/li-tak-ensemble.html, sha256 44c30588b5c8b7aaa7bd9fbe26cf2a3b5bbe9cea273f600398955bccce21d770), Offene Stellen https://www.tak.li/offene-stellen (files/m10/li-tak-stellen.html, sha256 157bd8e67bc4b4e0cd892ecd5ebe4b36f0ffd873f9306db0755d560f5e2c21a6) read; Amt für Volkswirtschaft's GAV page https://www.llv.li/de/unternehmen/arbeit-und-personal/gesamtarbeitsvertraege (403) (items 8, 9) (the stage actor's minimum, the methods round of 2026-11-04). Result: TAK names an acting ensemble for 2026/27 ('Das Ensemble der Spielzeit 2026/27 Wir sind Alexander, Andy, André, Antonia, Christiani, Georg, Nicole, Oliver, Stefan, Susanne und Thomas'), so stage actors are engaged in Liechtenstein; the site publishes no terms, and 'Derzeit ist kein Stellenangebot online'. Nothing on playwrights' fees or royalties. The state's GAV page refused (403).
tried.official-register: Lilex, the state's consolidated-law database (Rechtsdienst der Regierung) https://www.gesetze.li/konso/suche, title search 'Gesamtarbeitsvertrag', law in force on 04.11.2026 (files/m10/li-gesetze-gav2.html, sha256 456cb4b80b0bed0e9c79e8b54b0db9eba863c8c09970110f491716e9f31de585), the result list read whole (items 8, 9) (the stage actor's minimum, the methods round of 2026-11-04). Result: 15 ordinances declaring a collective agreement generally binding (LR 215.215.012-029): plasterers and painters, motor trade, builders, gardeners, carpenters and roofers, joiners, building services, stove and tile, electrical, IT, metal, retail, cleaning, temporary staffing, upholsterers and floorers. None for theatre, performers or authors: no stage actor's or playwright's agreement is in force as generally binding.
tried.trade-press: Compendium of Cultural Policies and Trends, Liechtenstein 3.3 https://www.culturalpolicies.net/country_profile/liechtenstein-3-3/ (files/m10/li-cp-33.html, sha256 0c6a73493de0098d62ef8b30bde9000e96d8096c8f3ceb1869c361f6fccf8e66) read (no primary address given); Liechtensteiner Vaterland search https://www.vaterland.li/suche?q=TAK+Ensemble+Schauspieler (404); Liechtensteiner Volksblatt search (TLS verification failed: unable to get local issuer certificate; verification kept on) (producer blocker: theatre fund; items 8, 9) (the stage actor's minimum, the methods round of 2026-11-04). Result: The Compendium: TAK 'serves the functions of a state theatre'; the state supports the cooperative 'Theater am Kirchplatz eG' 'under a performance agreement. Financial support has been at CHF 2.1 million since 2013 and will continue to be in that amount for the 2022–2025 theatre season'; 'Since 2019/2020, the theatre has had its own acting ensemble … from Liechtenstein, Switzerland, Austria and Germany'. Nothing on the ensemble's pay, playwrights' fees or a series fund; the press searches were not reached.
